name: Journey
overview: The biblical concept of journey emphasizes God’s guidance, provision, and protection throughout the believer's path. From Abraham's call to leave his homeland (Genesis 12:1) to the Lord leading Israel by a pillar of cloud and fire (Exodus 13:21), Scripture reveals that God directs His people both day and night. The psalmist affirms God's comforting presence even in the darkest valleys (Psalms 23:4) and highlights the Word of God as a guiding light for our steps (Psalms 119:105). Trusting in the Lord rather than our own understanding (Proverbs 3:5) ensures that God preserves our going out and coming in forevermore (Psalms 121:8).
